'''Arthur Louis Buikema Jr.''' (February 4, 1941 – June 10, 2026) was an American biologist and [[Ecology|ecologist]].

== Early life and career ==
Buikema was born in [[Cook County, Illinois]], on February 4, 1941, the son of Arthur Louis Buikema Sr. and Jesse Marion Ebbens. He was raised in his family's [[farm]] in [[Beecher, Illinois]]. He attended [[Elmhurst University]], earning his [[bachelor's degree]]. He also attended the [[University of Kansas]], earning his [[master's degree]] and his [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD degree]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://nrvnews.com/buikema-jr-arthur-louis/|title=Buikema, Jr., Arthur Louis|work=New River Valley News|date=June 11, 2026|access-date=June 21, 2026}}</ref>

He served as a professor in the department of [[Biology|biological science]]s at [[Virginia Tech]] from 1971 to 2015.<ref name="a">{{Cite web|url=https://www.mccoyfuneralhome.com/obituaries/arthur-buikema/#!/Obituary|title=Arthur Louis Buikema Jr.|work=McCoy Funeral Home|access-date=June 21, 2026}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://news.vt.edu/articles/2015/06/060315-science-buikemaemeritus.html|title=Arthur L. Buikema honored with emeritus status|work=[[Virginia Tech]]|date=June 3, 2015|access-date=June 21, 2026}}</ref> During his years as a professor, he was named the Alumni [[Distinguished professor|Distinguished Professor]] of Ecology.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.biol.vt.edu/faculty/buikema/index.html|title=Arthur Buikema|work=[[Virginia Tech]]|access-date=June 21, 2026}}</ref>

== Personal life and death ==
Buikema was married to Mary Alison Galway. Their marriage lasted until Buikema's death in 2026.<ref name="a" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://regionalobituaries.com/obituary/arthur-louis-buikema-jr/|title=Arthur Louis Buikema|work=Regional Obituaries|access-date=June 21, 2026}}</ref>

Buikema died in [[Blacksburg, Virginia]], on June 10, 2026, at the age of 85.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.echovita.com/us/obituaries/va/blacksburg/arthur-buikema-jr-21674129|title=Arthur Louis Buikema Jr.|work=Echovita|access-date=June 21, 2026}}</ref>
